start: ^Jordan Pike: Hey! Honestly, no pressure, but you look like a Keyholder. Here, leaflet. Nobody applies, you get found. Solve the numbers, the lockbox opens, and you're in the Trials.
^Jordan Pike: Nine grand a year and fees paid. It's literally free money.

s0: ^Any questions? I get a referral bonus, so ask away.

c-0: ^Jordan Pike: Data recovery. Companies get hit by ransomware, CryptoSecure gets them back up. Very busy, apparently.
c-1: ^Jordan Pike: Two of us work for them now. Placements, then jobs. They ask some odd questions, to be fair. I don't ask back.
c-2: ^Jordan Pike: Some email thing they sell. Tells you when people open stuff? No idea how. I just do the stand.
c-3: ^Jordan Pike: Nice one. Lockbox is right there.
